article.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
article.summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
